question.text: Which of the following actions can SEBI take against an intermediary found guilty of fraudulent and unfair trade practices?

answer.text: Issue a warning or censure, suspend the registration, or cancel the registration

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the PFUTP Regulations, SEBI may take any of these actions against an intermediary: (i) issue a warning or censure, (ii) suspend the registration, or (iii) cancel the registration (workbook p. 147). Option C captures the full menu of available actions. The Trap: The "only warning", "only suspend", and "only cancel" choices each describe a single tool from a list of three and are therefore incomplete. The question asks which choice covers all the actions that SEBI may take. Note: The workbook review item on p. 157 likewise treats both suspension and cancellation of registration as available enforcement actions against intermediaries.
